scope: Design documents and derived static tool candidate review only; no product implementation

checks: AST class location and literal tool name
catalog_review.limitations: Non-test static candidate does not establish live registration, semantics, effects, authorization or reuse suitability. Inherited/computed metadata and external MCPs were not resolved.
catalog_review.verification_note: Duplicate groups compare record contents independent of source traversal versus sorted candidate order; exact membership verified.

coverage_review.detail: Catalog identity/views/loading/lifecycle; original discovery reuse; input/output contracts; model invocation; progress/retry/budgets; replay/evaluation; derived memory correction/deletion; deployment lifecycle; minimal first implementation and evidence-based expansion.

runtime_validation.detail: Product build/test/lint/typecheck, live registry/MCP/model calls, tool selection and performance benchmarks, correction/deletion propagation, runtime replay/recovery, and external channel integration were not run.
